title: Hardware Startup: Seed Round Decision
description: Your hardware product has early customer validation. Decide whether to bootstrap the first manufacturing run, raise a seed round, or pursue crowdfunding — each path has very different timelines, dilution, and failure modes.

decision.prompt: Choose your capital strategy for the first manufacturing run.

options.label: Raise a seed round
options.description: Raise $500k-$1.5M from angels or a pre-seed fund. Faster capital but meaningful dilution (15-25%) and board dynamics to manage. Requires 3-6 months of fundraising.

options.label: Launch on Kickstarter or Indiegogo
options.description: Pre-sell to backers to fund the manufacturing run without dilution. Validates demand publicly and generates press, but exposes your roadmap and creates delivery risk.

options.label: Bootstrap via direct pre-sales
options.description: Sell directly to early enterprise or prosumer customers at a premium. Slowest path but zero dilution and real revenue from day one.

minimum_order_quantity.label: Minimum Order Quantity (units)
minimum_order_quantity.description: Number of units in the first production run. Affects unit economics dramatically.

unit_cogs_usd.label: Unit COGS ($)
unit_cogs_usd.description: Cost of goods sold per unit at the MOQ volume.

target_gross_margin.label: Target Gross Margin
target_gross_margin.description: Target gross margin — drives retail price and long-term sustainability.

seed_raise_amount_usd.label: Seed Raise Target ($)
seed_raise_amount_usd.description: Target amount to raise if pursuing a venture seed round.

manufacturing_lead_time_weeks.label: Manufacturing Lead Time (weeks)
manufacturing_lead_time_weeks.description: Weeks from purchase order to finished goods at your factory.

months_of_runway.label: Months of Runway Remaining
months_of_runway.description: How many months of personal or existing cash you have before needing product revenue.
